whoosh.wav.use: very short (0.15 s) low air swish: a quick cut, a small card flick; darker than sfx2 whooshes
whoosh.wav.processing: 48 kHz 24-bit, DC high-pass 22 Hz, 2 ms / 12 ms raised-cosine edge fades, peak -1.5 dBFS

skipped.mouse-click: screen: HF_HEAVY (100 % of energy > 4 kHz) - thin, sharp double click; sfx2/ui_click_a/b instead
skipped.switch: screen: HF_HEAVY (71 % > 4 kHz), starts/ends mid-signal - plasticky click; sfx2/ui_click_b instead
skipped.ding: licence: Remotion says it is 'not explicitly released under a free license' (myinstants) - also 97 % of its energy in 2-6 kHz; sfx2/glass_chime_* instead
skipped.shutter-modern: screen: NOISY_HF + HARSH_ONSET + CRACKLE - mechanical clatter
skipped.page-turn: screen: HF_HEAVY (72 % > 4 kHz); the file is actually Kenney 'Draw Knife 1' (blade scrape)
skipped.whip: briefed out (a whip crack); the file is a racquet swish with a sharp crack transient
skipped.snapchat-notification / mac-quack: brand / meme sounds - not ours to borrow for a product launch
skipped.vine-boom / bone-crack / record-scratch: meme, impact, crack or error sounds - banned by the client rule (screen: THUMP / CRACKLE / PITCH_DIVE / ABRUPT_END)

policy: Taken only if CC0 / free, screened clean (analysis/check_sfx.py) and in the glassy-soft brief.
